fixtureProtocol.textInput: Pass text unchanged. For kind=bytes convert lower-case hex pairs to a Uint8Array; replace hex with bytes. Extra source-envelope fields stay present for negative cases.
fixtureProtocol.coreCase: Validate the pair then allocate on success. Collect batch artifact first and every class roster in original workshop order. Compare the exact artifact text and bytes in each locale.
fixtureProtocol.generatedBoundary: literal copies text; repeat is prefix + unit repeated count times + suffix; numbered is header + LF + joined records with LF, replacing {n} by decimal integers from first through last padded to width. Compare specified literal result fields. Bytes counts include UTF-8 content and any BOM.
fixtureProtocol.controllerCase: New controller per case; INIT inspects initial state without dispatch. LOAD converts hex to bytes. fixtureThrow configures the fake adapter for that event and is removed before dispatch. Check every full expected snapshot and ordered effect list after the event. Fake create returns blob:fixture/N starting at N=1 per case; increment N even after failed download.
